name: byted-basic-working-principles
description: Read before starting or continuing a video creation or editing task: reviewing source material, planning a script or storyboard, preparing visuals, assembling or revising a cut, adjusting captions or sound, checking results, or exporting. Use even for a small correction or when a scenario skill is already selected. Establishes shared rules for following the brief, preserving source meaning and existing edits, acting within scope, verifying results, and reporting completion honestly.
